app: Compliant design (synthetic control): one offer per flagship subscription recorded before any code is printed -- reference name, target product, eligibility (new + expired), introductory-offer interaction set to code-first, all 175 storefronts, free for 3 months then renew to standard price; quarterly pool and the 10-active-offer ceiling tracked in the campaign ledger; the In-App Purchase Key upload to the billing layer is recorded with its date. The paywall and Settings both carry a localised Redeem entry that presents the system redemption sheet, and every distributed code also ships as a prefilled redemption URL. The purchases delegate and CustomerInfo stream are registered during SDK configuration; nothing in the flow reads a return value from the sheet. Leaving via a redemption URL is recorded, and foreground return calls syncPurchases before re-rendering; Restore remains on the paywall as the final fallback. The subscription mapping keeps the offer period distinct from a trial, and paywall/settings render only from the live entitlement. Every redemption is counted by offer reference name in analytics and the billing webhook; code batches carry recorded expiry dates with a named owner, deactivation is a recorded deliberate act, and a sandbox-code redemption (sheet + URL + external) is tested and logged before each campaign.
